title: Mann's alpha plus beta theorem for Schnirelmann density, after Mann 1942
abstract: A Lean 4 proof, with no unproved steps, of the theorem of H. B. Mann, A proof of the fundamental theorem on the density of sums of sets of positive integers, Ann. of Math. 43, 1942: for sets A and B of natural numbers that contain 0, the Schnirelmann density of A + B is at least the minimum of 1 and sigma A + sigma B. It is stated for Mathlib's own schnirelmannDensity and Mathlib's pointwise sum of sets, so the Challenge restates no density definition, and it is also proved for any finite number of sets. This fills a Mathlib TODO: Mathlib/Combinatorics/Schnirelmann.lean lists Mann's theorem as not yet proved. The proof goes through the rank h case of Dyson's theorem, following Nathanson, arXiv 2407.12253. Binary Goldbach is open and is not claimed. The Lean code was written by an AI agent and is offered for human audit.
